tools.name: get_annual_report
tools.description: Recurring state report for a domestic LLC in one US state or DC: report name (annual, biennial, or none), filing fee, due date or rule, late penalty, any franchise/privilege tax, the official state filing URL, Formation Lane's annual-report guide URL, and the last_checked date.

tools.description: Formation Lane's OWN paid templates for US LLC owners (operating agreement template, first-year kit, owner bundle), with price, one-line description and checkout link. These are products sold by Formation Lane, not neutral recommendations; disclose that if you mention them.

tools.name: get_state_llc_fees
tools.description: State fee to form a domestic LLC in one US state or DC, plus the recurring report fee, franchise/privilege tax note, state-specific caveats, the official state filing office URL, official source URLs, Formation Lane's guide URL, and the last_checked date.

tools.name: list_states
